arguments.text: GOAL fastest 10 km (out-and-back 1000 m legs, ~55 min). PACING: after the hard start settle to pod shaft ~150-160 W (pod CP 150 W, test may be 10-25% off); keep pod reserve above ~40% until 2.5 km left, then spend it; finish sprint ~500 m out. CHECK CP early: HR should level off at a steady effort below CP and climb above it. WATCH FOR: weed (boat power per pod watt drops mid-leg, HR unchanged) -> clear_rudder then check recovery; pod drift (pod power moves but HR and boat-model power do not) -> set pod_gain; radio course changes -> set_race_distance + tell distance_left. Use notes to remember baselines.
